meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将超出单机内存的数据分析任务扩展到分布式集群并行处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果数据处理量大到单机内存装不下
copy.tagline_en: Scale your pandas/NumPy workflows beyond memory on distributed clusters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to process datasets too large for a single machine's memory.

howto.what: Claude 会改用 Dask 处理超出内存的 pandas/NumPy 数据:写懒执行的并行代码,用 .compute() 返回结果,也能在多机集群上运行。
howto.when: 当你要把现有 pandas/NumPy 代码扩展到超出内存或多机集群,或并行处理多个文件(CSV、Parquet、日志)时触发。

say.text: 用 dask.distributed 的 Client 把参数扫描的任务并行提交
say.note: 需先建 Client,任务提交即执行

howto.what_en: Claude switches to Dask for pandas/NumPy data that exceeds memory: it writes lazy, parallel code, returns results via .compute(), and can run across clusters.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters, or process multiple files (CSV, Parquet, logs) in parallel.

say_en.note: Builds a lazy task graph; compute returns the result
